investigation.title: Remote Agents: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Agent Provisioning Evals (production-api)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-21T00:27–00:28Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api layer could not reach the swarm ELB endpoint at /v1/agents. Because the failure occurs before any agent is provisioned, zero required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected, and all contract assertions are unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting the /v1/agents provisioning path — was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. The production-api returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning" for every POST /api/agents call. Because all three sibling checks share the same upstream dependency (the swarm ELB) and all returned the identical error message within a 34-second window, the failure is localized to that shared infrastructure dependency, not to individual check logic or eval runner code. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact is scoped to the observability eval layer.
